//: EMULATOR-ONLY config for the Mercado Livre Cloud Tasks round-trip lane (ci-mercado-livre.yml: `firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.mercado-livre.tasks.json --only firestore,functions,tasks`). ⚠️ NOT a deploy config — that is `firebase.mercado-livre.deploy.json`, which is the one carrying `predeploy`. This one points `source` at the SAME generated `.deploy/mercado-livre-functions` artifact, but emulators:exec does NOT run predeploy hooks, so the lane must invoke prepare-deploy.mjs itself first. It declares no rules and no indexes, so a stray `firebase deploy` here can push only the functions codebase — never rules. The tasks port is pinned rather than left to auto-assign: firebase-tools' controller.ts reads `listenForEmulator.eventarc` in the tasks slot on the late-port-assignment path, so an explicit port avoids that. Ports are distinct from firebase.functions.json (8080/5001), firebase.rules.json (8081) and firebase.mercado-livre.json (8082).
